end.parentNote: Asha practised equal sharing and naming fractions such as one-third and two-thirds. Nisha identified some equal-part shapes and counted total parts, but sometimes described the parts left instead of the parts out of the whole; this was not corrected by the end. At home, share a roti or paper circle into equal pieces and ask, “How many equal parts altogether?” and “How many are we talking about?”
